# Calendar

```ts
import { Calendar } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Calendar is the cake& date panel (Figma &calendar, node 4890:20174): a compact month grid with Month/Year pickers and Today / Cancel / OK. Date Input and Date Range Picker open it in a Radix Popover, aligned to the calendar icon; this page documents the panel on its own so the Figma states (default, selected 1, selected 2, month picker, year picker) can be audited without a field.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `'single' \| 'range'` | `'single'` | Single-date grid or a start/end range (Figma selected 1 vs selected 2). |
| `value` | `Date \| null` | — | Controlled selected date for mode="single". |
| `defaultValue` | `Date \| null` | — | Uncontrolled initial date for mode="single". |
| `onValueChange` | `(date: Date \| null) => void` | — | Fires on each day click in single mode (draft). OK still goes through onConfirm. |
| `rangeValue` | `CalendarRangeValue` | — | Controlled start/end for mode="range". |
| `defaultRangeValue` | `CalendarRangeValue` | — | Uncontrolled initial range. |
| `onRangeValueChange` | `(range: CalendarRangeValue) => void` | — | Fires on each range-draft change. |
| `defaultView` | `'day' \| 'month' \| 'year'` | `'day'` | Starting inner view. Stories use this to show the month/year pickers. |
| `onToday` | `() => void` | `'Choose date' */` | Accessible name for the panel. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | — | Footer Cancel. |
| `onConfirm` | `(next: Date \| CalendarRangeValue \| null) => void` | — | Footer OK. Receives the draft single date or range. |


## Usage

```tsx
<Calendar />
<Calendar defaultValue={new Date(2026, 2, 15)} />
<Calendar mode="range" defaultRangeValue={{ start: new Date(2026, 2, 14), end: new Date(2026, 2, 19) }} />
<Calendar defaultView="month" />
<Calendar defaultView="year" />
<Calendar onConfirm={apply} onCancel={close} />
```

## Accessibility

- The panel is a role="dialog" labelled "Choose date" (override with aria-label). Days sit in a role="grid" named by the visible month.
- Selected days set aria-selected; today sets aria-current="date".
- Month and Year buttons are aria-pressed while that picker is open. Prev/next IconButtons have view-specific names (month, year, or year page).
- Footer actions are real cake& Buttons. Focus rings use the primary stroke token; never remove them.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Open Calendar from Date Input / Date Range Picker in product UI. | Drop a native <input type="date"> picker next to these fields. |
| Treat OK as commit and Cancel as discard. | Write the field on every day click unless the product is a live preview. |
| Use mode="range" for an interval — the ribbon wraps across rows. | Simulate a range by coordinating two unrelated Calendars. |
| Let Month/Year pickers change the displayed grid. | Paginate years with a free-text year field beside the grid. |
